entries.06271b704d440a8d: Medical equipment and facility sales companies
entries.09b01259e91ed2e8: The company is headquartered in Onojo, Fukuoka Prefecture, and is engaged in the planning, development, design and sale of electric medical and nursing care beds and bed peripheral equipment such as mattresses.
entries.0cf71c3d365b6ed3: This is a business selling electric medical and nursing care beds mainly in China and other East Asian regions, such as South Korea, Hong Kong and Vietnam. In China, Fu Ruo Ci (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, handles sales, a joint venture with the Haier Group manufactures products for the local market, and the company provides technical guidance. Sales to overseas markets for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥182 million.
entries.1761c9dbea5b242a: A company that sells electric beds and mattresses for medical and nursing care, centered on the welfare equipment distribution market, and also expands to medical and elderly care facilities and overseas markets in East Asia.
entries.1a67b730c70102cd: Home-Use Nursing Care Beds: 'Yokaro', 'Miorette III', 'Miorette III Next'
entries.1f61957481e6cee1: These are electric medical and nursing care beds sold for home care through welfare equipment rental operators and rental wholesalers. Under the long-term care insurance system, they are classified as 'special beds.' The basic lineup consists of 3 models, 'Yokaro,' 'Miorettō III,' and 'Miorettō III Nekusuto,' and the company also handles the bed grip 'Nīparo Purasu' as a peripheral product. Sales to the welfare equipment distribution market for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥4,641 million.
entries.2cd6ac870d442b31: Based on the market environment descriptions in 'Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Address' and 'Management's Analysis of Financial Position, Operating Results and Cash Flows'.
entries.2cf8bca7840af742: The company operates its business with 'high quality, high functionality and low price' as its strengths. It has a production system covering everything from manufacturing steel parts, the key components of its main products, to quality inspection and assembly, and its own quality control department guides and manages quality inspection. The home-use nursing care bed 'Yokaro' is a product developed through industry-academia collaboration, with medical functionality and design.
entries.369cef42d05d886b: Management policies are expanding the domestic market and challenging new fields, strengthening manufacturing functions, strengthening the management base and the human resource development that leads to it, and strengthening overseas operations (East and Southeast Asia). The company aims to establish a top industry share in home nursing care beds and the No2 position in beds for medical and elderly care facilities, and to expand revenue sources through bed-related products and product development in new fields, as well as to deploy services that address the industry's labor shortage. In manufacturing, the company will advance the development of production sites, investment in research and development, and strengthening of development and purchasing functions; overseas, it will advance joint venture projects in China, promote collaboration with partners in South Korea, and build the foundation for developing East and Southeast Asia.

entries.4f36e00b65d0a4cf: The company is headquartered in Onojo, Fukuoka Prefecture, and is engaged in the planning, development, design and sale of electric medical and nursing care beds and bed peripheral equipment such as mattresses. The group consists of 2 consolidated subsidiaries, Fu Ruo Ci (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., which sells products in China, and Yamato Sangyo Co., Ltd., which processes and sells urethane foam, and 1 equity-method affiliate that manufactures in Vietnam. As of June 30, 2026, the number of employees is 150. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market and the Fukuoka Stock Exchange Q-Board Market. Net sales for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥8,294 million.

Established in 1992 as Yugen Kaisha Kyushu Waken, the company is a group with two consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate. The number of employees as of June 30, 2026 is 150. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Q-Board market of the Fukuoka Stock Exchange.

It also supplies wholesale to furniture stores and mail-order businesses. Sales to the furniture and bedding distribution market for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥1,149 million.

Sales results for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥4,641 million for the welfare equipment distribution market, ¥2,321 million for the medical and elderly care facility market, ¥1,149 million for the furniture and bedding distribution market, and ¥182 million for overseas markets.

entries.cbaa29b2c1160c2a: The business model plans, develops and designs electric beds for medical and nursing care, and sells products manufactured by affiliates and others to welfare equipment rental providers, rental wholesalers, and sales companies serving medical and elderly care facilities, thereby earning revenue.
entries.d01ef822cedec78d: The company's management policy is to establish a top industry share in home nursing care beds and the No2 position in beds for medical and elderly care facilities. The number of uses of special beds under the welfare equipment rental system continues to rise, and the total number of persons certified as requiring support or nursing care is also increasing.
entries.ea85b5821f6f9c6b: This is a business selling electric medical and nursing care beds mainly in China and other East Asian regions, such as South Korea, Hong Kong and Vietnam.
entries.ebc549dd67d8e558: These are electric medical and nursing care beds sold to hospitals and elderly care facilities through medical equipment and facility sales companies, and others. The company offers 5 types: the 'P300 series' and 'P302 series' for medical facilities, the 'P301 series' for dialysis rooms, and 'Āderu' and 'Reisuto' for elderly care facilities. Sales to the medical and elderly care facility market for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥2,321 million.
entries.f69fcb7358f3c288: Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥8,294 million, a decrease from the previous year. Sales to the medical and elderly care facility market and to overseas markets increased, but sales to the welfare equipment distribution market declined slightly, and in the furniture and bedding distribution market, demand slowed for some mattress product lines handled by a consolidated subsidiary. The challenges identified are to focus on the medical and elderly care facility market while building on revenue from the welfare equipment distribution market, and to secure revenue sources beyond beds through bed-related products such as mattresses and products and services in new fields.
entries.f96d8d1dfc87b006: Revenue from sales of electric beds for medical and nursing care
entries.fd43a4e3fbcd29ef: Main customers are welfare equipment rental businesses and rental wholesalers, and electric beds for medical and nursing care are rented to certified persons requiring nursing care as 'special beds' under the long-term care insurance system. In addition, the company sells through medical equipment and facility sales companies to medical and elderly care facilities, and also sells to furniture stores, bedding wholesalers and the East Asia region. Nihon Care Supply Co., Ltd. and Nishikawa Co., Ltd. are disclosed as major customers.
